```{r}
r1c2_het <- new.env()
r1c2_hom <- new.env()

load(here::here("Results", "Predictions_het.RData"), envir = r1c2_het)
load(here::here("Results", "Predictions_hom.RData"), envir = r1c2_hom)

r1c2_id <- bind_rows(
  r1c2_het$dat_pm %>%
    filter(iter == 0) %>%
    mutate(Model = "Het"),
  r1c2_hom$dat_pm_hom %>%
    filter(iter == 0) %>%
    mutate(Model = "Hom")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Test = sub("-Hom$", "", Test),
    elements = (Mo > 0) + (Nb > 0) + (Ta > 0) + (V > 0) + (W > 0),
    Cohort = if_else(
      elements == 2,
      "Binary interpolation",
      "Higher-order extrapolation"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Test, Step, Kernel, mean_type,
         id = id_obs, alloy_cnt, Cohort)

r1c2_pred_order <- dat_pred %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(alloy_cnt) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
  select(id, alloy_cnt)

r1c2_check <- r1c2_id %>%
  filter(Model == "Het", Test == "Compression", Step == "pol_m32") %>%
  arrange(id)

stopifnot(
  nrow(r1c2_id) == 1296L,
  nrow(r1c2_check) == 81L,
  all(r1c2_check$alloy_cnt == r1c2_pred_order$alloy_cnt),
  !anyDuplicated(r1c2_id[c("Model", "Test", "Step", "id")])
)

r1c2_map_check <- r1c2_id %>%
  group_by(Test, Step, id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_alloy = n_distinct(alloy_cnt),
    n_model = n_distinct(Model),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  all(r1c2_map_check$n_alloy == 1L),
  all(r1c2_map_check$n_model == 2L)
)
```

```{r}
r1c2_long <- function(dat, model, value_name) {
  dat %>%
    filter(iter == 0) %>%
    mutate(
      Model = model,
      Test = sub("-Hom$", "", Test)
    ) %>%
    select(Model, Test, Step, Kernel, mean_type,
           id, all_of(properties)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(properties),
      names_to = "property",
      values_to = value_name
    )
}

r1c2_key <- c("Model", "Test", "Step", "Kernel", "mean_type", "id")

r1c2_pred <- r1c2_id %>%
  inner_join(
    bind_rows(
      r1c2_long(r1c2_het$dat_mu, "Het", "mu"),
      r1c2_long(r1c2_hom$dat_mu_hom, "Hom", "mu")
    ),
    by = r1c2_key
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    bind_rows(
      r1c2_long(r1c2_het$dat_var, "Het", "variance"),
      r1c2_long(r1c2_hom$dat_var_hom, "Hom", "variance")
    ),
    by = c(r1c2_key, "property")
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(r1c2_pred) == 9072L,
  all(is.finite(r1c2_pred$mu)),
  all(is.finite(r1c2_pred$variance) & r1c2_pred$variance > 0)
)

# Do not use dat_comp here: it averages replicates by composition.
r1c2_obs <- bind_rows(
  dat_ss_c_all %>% mutate(Test = "Compression"),
  dat_ss_t_all %>% mutate(Test = "Tension")
) %>%
  filter(alloy_cnt %in% r1c2_id$alloy_cnt) %>%
  mutate(
    obs_id = row_number(),
    elements = (Mo > 0) + (Nb > 0) + (Ta > 0) + (V > 0),
    Cohort = if_else(
      elements == 2,
      "Binary interpolation",
      "Higher-order extrapolation"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Test, alloy_cnt, alloy_rep_id, obs_id, rep,
         Cohort, all_of(properties)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(properties),
    names_to = "property",
    values_to = "observed"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(r1c2_obs) == 2954L,
  all(is.finite(r1c2_obs$observed)),
  !anyDuplicated(
    r1c2_obs[c("Test", "alloy_cnt", "rep", "property")]
  )
)

r1c2_obs %>%
  distinct(Test, Cohort, obs_id) %>%
  count(Test, Cohort)
```


```{r}
r1c2_pred_duplicates <- r1c2_pred %>%
  count(Test, alloy_cnt, property, Model, Step, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n != 1L)
if (nrow(r1c2_pred_duplicates)) {
  print(r1c2_pred_duplicates, n = Inf)
  stop("Prediction rows are duplicated for some compositions.")
}

r1c2_unmatched <- r1c2_obs %>%
  anti_join(r1c2_pred, by = c("Test", "alloy_cnt", "property"))
if (nrow(r1c2_unmatched)) {
  print(r1c2_unmatched %>% count(Test, Cohort, alloy_cnt, property), n = Inf)
  stop("Some observed curves have no matching prediction.")
}

r1c2_z <- qnorm(0.975)
r1c2_scores <- r1c2_obs %>%
  left_join(
    r1c2_pred %>% select(-Cohort),
    by = c("Test", "alloy_cnt", "property"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd = sqrt(variance),
    lower95 = mu - r1c2_z * sd,
    upper95 = mu + r1c2_z * sd,
    covered95 = observed >= lower95 & observed <= upper95,
    AE = abs(observed - mu),
    SE = (observed - mu)^2,
    NLPD = 0.5 * log(2 * pi * variance) + SE / (2 * variance)
  )

r1c2_match_counts <- r1c2_scores %>%
  count(obs_id, property, name = "matched_models")
r1c2_model_count <- r1c2_pred %>% distinct(Model, Step) %>% nrow()
print(r1c2_match_counts %>% count(matched_models))
if (any(r1c2_match_counts$matched_models != r1c2_model_count) ||
    any(!is.finite(r1c2_scores$NLPD))) {
  print(r1c2_match_counts %>%
          filter(matched_models != r1c2_model_count), n = Inf)
  stop("Some observations have missing or duplicated model predictions.")
}

print(r1c2_obs %>% distinct(Test, Cohort, obs_id) %>% count(Test, Cohort))
print(r1c2_scores %>% distinct(Test, Cohort, Model, Step, obs_id) %>%
        count(Test, Cohort, Model, Step), n = Inf)

# Width is a model prediction for a composition, not a replicate score.
# dat_var already contains the new-replication nugget.
r1c2_width <- r1c2_scores %>%
  distinct(Model, Test, Step, Kernel, mean_type, Cohort,
           alloy_cnt, property, variance) %>%
  mutate(width95 = 2 * r1c2_z * sqrt(variance)) %>%
  select(-variance)
r1c2_width_duplicates <- r1c2_width %>%
  count(Model, Test, Step, alloy_cnt, property, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n != 1L)
if (nrow(r1c2_width_duplicates)) {
  print(r1c2_width_duplicates, n = Inf)
  stop("Interval width is not unique by composition and model.")
}

r1c2_joint <- r1c2_scores %>%
  group_by(Model, Test, Step, Kernel, mean_type, Cohort,
           alloy_cnt, alloy_rep_id, obs_id, rep) %>%
  summarise(joint_NLPD = sum(NLPD),
            n_outputs = n(), .groups = "drop")
if (any(r1c2_joint$n_outputs != length(properties))) {
  stop("A joint score does not contain all seven response components.")
}
```


```{r}
r1c2_accuracy <- r1c2_scores %>%
  group_by(Cohort, Test, Model, Step, Kernel, mean_type, property) %>%
  summarise(observations = n(), MAE = mean(AE),
            RMSE = sqrt(mean(SE)), mean_NLPD = mean(NLPD),
            median_NLPD = median(NLPD),
            coverage95 = 100 * mean(covered95), .groups = "drop")
r1c2_sharpness <- r1c2_width %>%
  group_by(Cohort, Test, Model, Step, Kernel, mean_type, property) %>%
  summarise(compositions = n(), mean_width95 = mean(width95),
            median_width95 = median(width95), .groups = "drop")
r1c2_summary_all <- left_join(
  r1c2_accuracy, r1c2_sharpness,
  by = c("Cohort", "Test", "Model", "Step", "Kernel",
         "mean_type", "property"))

write_csv(r1c2_scores,
          here::here("Results", "R1C2_each_observation_all_specs.csv"))
write_csv(r1c2_width,
          here::here("Results", "R1C2_width_each_composition_all_specs.csv"))
write_csv(r1c2_summary_all,
          here::here("Results", "R1C2_Het_Hom_summary_all_specs.csv"))

# Paper-selected mean/kernel setting for each test cohort and loading.
r1c2_paper <- tribble(
  ~Cohort, ~Test, ~mean_type, ~Kernel,
  "Binary interpolation", "Compression", "pol", "m32",
  "Binary interpolation", "Tension", "int", "m32",
  "Higher-order extrapolation", "Compression", "pol", "m52",
  "Higher-order extrapolation", "Tension", "int", "m32"
)
r1c2_key <- c("Cohort", "Test", "mean_type", "Kernel")
r1c2_scores_paper <- inner_join(r1c2_scores, r1c2_paper, by = r1c2_key)
r1c2_width_paper <- inner_join(r1c2_width, r1c2_paper, by = r1c2_key)
r1c2_joint_paper <- inner_join(r1c2_joint, r1c2_paper, by = r1c2_key)
r1c2_summary_paper <- inner_join(r1c2_summary_all, r1c2_paper, by = r1c2_key)

print(r1c2_summary_paper %>%
        select(Cohort, Test, Model, property, observations, compositions,
               MAE, RMSE, mean_NLPD, coverage95, mean_width95),
      n = Inf)

write_csv(r1c2_scores_paper,
          here::here("Results", "R1C2_each_observation.csv"))
write_csv(r1c2_width_paper,
          here::here("Results", "R1C2_width_each_composition.csv"))
write_csv(r1c2_summary_paper,
          here::here("Results", "R1C2_Het_Hom_summary.csv"))
write_csv(r1c2_joint_paper,
          here::here("Results", "R1C2_joint_NLPD_each_observation.csv"))
```

```{r}
r1c3_revision_root <- "C:/Users/AbsoluteArm/OneDrive - University of Oklahoma (1)/Metal_proj_c/SS-MHGP-EDL-revision/SS-MHGP-EDL-revision"

r1c3_case_file <- file.path(
  r1c3_revision_root, "Results", "Revision Tables",
  "table_03_representative_compositions.csv"
)
r1c3_eval_dir <- file.path(
  r1c3_revision_root, "Results", "Revision Evidence", "evaluation"
)
r1c3_output_dir <- here::here("Figures")

# These are the paper-selected HMVGPR configurations for each test set.
r1c3_models <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cohort,       ~loading, ~model,
  "binary_test",  "c",      "gp_linear_m32_diagonal_het_c",
  "binary_test",  "t",      "gp_constant_m32_diagonal_het_t",
  "higher_test",  "c",      "gp_linear_m52_diagonal_het_c",
  "higher_test",  "t",      "gp_constant_m32_diagonal_het_t"
)

r1c3_band_files <- file.path(
  r1c3_eval_dir, unique(r1c3_models$model), "curve_bands.csv.gz"
)
stopifnot(file.exists(r1c3_case_file), all(file.exists(r1c3_band_files)))
dir.create(r1c3_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

r1c3_cases <- readr::read_csv(
  r1c3_case_file, show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    cohort = dplyr::case_when(
      `Held-out set` == "Binary interpolation test" ~ "binary_test",
      `Held-out set` == "Higher-order test" ~ "higher_test",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    loading = dplyr::case_when(
      Loading == "Compression" ~ "c",
      Loading == "Tension" ~ "t",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    role = Role,
    composition = Composition,
    composition_id = `Composition ID`,
    rmse = `Mean RMSE (GPa)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(r1c3_models, by = c("cohort", "loading"))

stopifnot(nrow(r1c3_cases) == 16L, !anyNA(r1c3_cases$model))

r1c3_bands <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  r1c3_band_files,
  function(path) readr::read_csv(
    path,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    col_types = readr::cols(
      loading = readr::col_character(),
      .default = readr::col_guess()
    )
  )
))

r1c3_save_plot <- function(cohort_code, loading_code) {
  role_order <- c("Best", "Median", "Difficult", "Worst")

  selected <- r1c3_cases %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      cohort == cohort_code,
      loading == loading_code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(match(role, role_order)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      panel = paste0(
        role, ": ", composition,
        "\nRMSE ", sprintf("%.3f", rmse), " GPa"
      )
    )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(selected) == 4L,
    identical(selected$role, role_order)
  )

  plot_data <- r1c3_bands %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      selected,
      by = c("model", "loading", "composition_id")
    )

  stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(plot_data$composition_id) == 4L)
  plot_data$panel <- factor(plot_data$panel, levels = selected$panel)

  # The prediction band is drawn on the longest observed domain.
  # All available atomistic replications remain visible in black.
  longest_curve <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      composition_id, panel, curve_id, observed_failure
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(composition_id, panel) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(observed_failure), curve_id,
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(composition_id, panel, curve_id)

  prediction_data <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(
      longest_curve,
      by = c("composition_id", "panel", "curve_id")
    )

  cohort_name <- if (cohort_code == "binary_test") {
    "Binary"
  } else {
    "Higher-Order"
  }
  loading_name <- if (loading_code == "c") {
    "Compression"
  } else {
    "Tension"
  }

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = prediction_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = strain, ymin = lower95, ymax = upper95,
        group = panel
      ),
      fill = "blue", alpha = 0.30
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = plot_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = strain, y = observed,
        group = interaction(panel, curve_id)
      ),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = prediction_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = strain, y = pred_mean, group = panel
      ),
      color = "blue", linewidth = 1.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 2, scales = "free") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste(
        "Predicted SS Curves for", cohort_name,
        "Alloys under", loading_name
      ),
      x = latex2exp::TeX("Strain $\\epsilon$"),
      y = latex2exp::TeX("Stress $\\sigma$ (GPa)")
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  stem <- paste0(
    "figure_03_representative_curves_",
    cohort_code, "_", loading_code
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(r1c3_output_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")),
    plot = p, width = 8, height = 6,
    units = "in", dpi = 400, bg = "white"
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(r1c3_output_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")),
    plot = p, width = 8, height = 6,
    units = "in", device = "pdf", bg = "white"
  )

  print(p)
  invisible(p)
}
```



```{r}
r1c3_save_plot("higher_test", "t")
r1c3_save_plot("higher_test", "c")
r1c3_save_plot("binary_test", "t")
r1c3_save_plot("binary_test", "c")
```
